aboutUs.title: Grow
aboutUs.body: A creative studio dedicated to sewing, embroidery, and design, here to guide you step by step on your learning journey. Here you'll find classes, tools, inspiration, and a community that grows with you.
aboutUs.question: Will you stay to discover everything you could achieve with your own hands?

daia.title: Hi! I'm Daia
daia.body: Fashion designer, graphic designer, seamstress, and passionate about embroidery in all its forms. I have more than ten years of experience sharing what I know and always learning. At Grow you don't have to adapt to a rigid system: we adapt to you, your pace, your schedule, and your desire to create.

recorded.desc: Access the content whenever you want, with no fixed schedule.

devices.title: FROM ANY DEVICE
devices.desc: Learn from your phone, tablet, or computer.

lifetime.title: LIFETIME ACCESS
lifetime.desc: Once you buy it, the course is yours forever.

expert.title: EXPERT INSTRUCTOR
expert.desc: Learn with Daia, a designer with more than 10 years of experience.

1.text: Beautiful place and a beautiful class ❤️ I highly recommend it! Dai makes learning to sew simple, fun, and practical 🙌🏽…

2.text: The best courses to learn from scratch, excellent experience!

3.text: I recommend it 100%. Daiana is a teacher with a lot of patience and passion for what she does; she has been supporting my learning process with great care and good energy. She gave me the tools to follow patterns on my own, so I can come back to class with specific questions. Within two weeks I was already making tote bags for my family, and by the end of the month I was altering a dress to my measurements. I learned a lot and made friends in her classes; I hold a lot of affection for this institute that has given me more than just learning to sew. Proud to be part of the Sydney branch.
